answer_1.quote: We evaluate our training approach across various architectures. Specifically, we conduct experiments using two language models—FiD and CEPE-Llama2-7B—as well as two rerankers—BGE-Reranker-Base and RankT5—and assess generation quality using the overall language modeling loss L_LM.

answer_2.quote: We consider three evaluation settings... Recall@5, NDCG@5, MRR, Exact Match (EM), SubEM, and F1 are reported to assess retrieval and generation performance.
